metadata.matching_definition: First complete syndrome-readout trigger ends -> original global barrier before final data readout; NOT a shared independent encoded-state preparation boundary
limitations: Three-round reference is pipelined; its first complete record is not a common independent encoding boundary.
New one-round shots and historical three-round shots are separate acquisitions; drift remains possible.
Current local controller settings with pinned historical gate calibration; not server timing verification.
Original primary one-round DEMs are frozen; extra CZ/readout/padding noise is not separately fitted.

assessment.caution: First-round readout completion is a record-availability timestamp, not a guaranteed common encoded-state boundary when extraction rounds overlap.
